basis: The six new uploads; no raw input logs or account secrets are copied into the repository.

apparmor.deduplication: Audit event id plus all parsed key/value fields; identical repeated access records counted once. Status/load records are not access failures.

dispositions.chromium: Outer profile disconnected-path flags and owner Crashpad memory read; two file_receive and two crash-handler accesses. Runtime replay required.
dispositions.managed-mullvad-vpn: Owner inherited PTY read/write; host-manager handoff and proc uid_map verification.
dispositions.managed-mullvad-daemon-start: Inherited authenticating-user PTY for the root helper. Authorization unchanged.
dispositions.managed-codex-wrapper: Missing git-ssh exec transition and null descendants -> new named managed-git-ssh profile; .system repairs excluded.
dispositions.managed-labwc-chatgpt: Missing git-ssh exec transition and null descendants -> same named profile.
dispositions.managed-desktop-launcher: Read-only apt/dpkg metadata; git-core inherit transition; read-only /data/codex/usr browsing, owner .git metadata and the specifically logged account-edit files. No .system write/exec grants.

journal.computer_management_status_2: Unresolved: the supplied log records a nonzero menu status but omits the cause. No broad status-2 success reclassification.
journal.codex_system_skills: Explicitly excluded at user request; no .system repair.
